verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. LORD, you have looked deep inside me, and you know me.
You know when I sit down and when I get up. You know my thoughts from far away.
You see where I go and when I lie down. You know everything I do.
Before a word is even on my tongue, LORD, you know all about it.
You surround me, behind me and in front of me. You lay your hand on me.
This knowledge is too wonderful for me. It is too great for me to understand.
Where could I go from your Spirit? Where could I run from your presence?
If I go up to heaven, you are there. If I lie down in the grave, you are there!
If I fly away on the wings of the dawn and settle on the far side of the sea,
even there your hand will guide me, and your right hand will hold me tight.
If I say, "Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light around me will become night,"
even the darkness is not dark to you. The night shines as bright as the day. Darkness is like light to you.
You made every part of me. You put me together inside my mother's womb.
I praise you, because you made me in such an amazing and wonderful way. What you have done is wonderful. I know that very well.
My body was not hidden from you when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
Your eyes saw me before I was born. All the days planned for me were written in your book before any of them came to be.
God, your thoughts are so precious to me! How many there are!
If I tried to count them, they would be more than the grains of sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
God, I wish you would kill the wicked! Get away from me, you murderers!
They speak evil things about you. Your enemies misuse your name.
LORD, don't I hate those who hate you? Don't I hate those who rise up against you?
I hate them completely. They are my enemies.
Look deep inside me, God, and know my heart. Test me and know my anxious thoughts.
See if there is any evil way in me, and lead me on the path that lasts forever.
